title: Knight Shadow
intro: My own character, my own story. Knight Shadow is the project I work on between commissions, and your support buys it more time at the drawing board.
paragraphs: Knight Shadow is a personal project: an original character and world, built from scratch rather than drawn from somebody else's universe.
Everything you see here is work in progress. Character art, designs and pages will be added as they are finished.
supportText: No rewards, no strings. If you like where this is going, chip in what you can and help it get made.
